Our Puma Dashboard™ kit , designed and manufactured in Lincolnshire, offers a seamless way to modernise your Defender without the usual complications. There’s no need to upgrade the bulkhead, no expensive rewiring, and you can reuse your original wiring loom, instrument gauges, fuse box, and heater. With a simple bolt-in installation, transforming your cabin is now a straightforward, stress-free process. Complementing the dashboard upgrade is our revolutionary 319 Integrated AC/Heater System . Traditional Defender air conditioning systems separate the heater and AC, leading to high humidity, fogged windows, and a damp interior.
